features.name: Core Platform Security
features.description: First-run auth, encrypted secrets, safe Console errors, Gateway health, reload, and shutdown.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/platform-security.unit.test.ts tests/features/runtime-lifecycle.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/platform-security.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/runtime-lifecycle.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-14: platform-security and runtime-lifecycle focused suites passed; verify, 85 E2E, feature regression, and Compose passed.
